sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:75

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:75:1
items.html: It is not far-fetched that his body was from the Land of Israel and his buttocks from Babylon, which are the two upper joints adjacent to the body. For the Land of Israel is the discernment of the world of Yetzira, whose four first ones were, before the sin, in the Nukva of Atzilut, and her six lower ones in the first six of Beria, that is, in the HBD HGT down to the Chazeh [chest] of Beria. And our sages do not speak of the head and throat of Adam HaRishon, but of his body, which is the discernment of the six lower ones of Yetzira, which were then in the first six of Beria. And the Malchut of Yetzira, which stands at the place of the Chazeh of Beria, is the discernment of Trans-Jordan, and she also includes the discernment of the four first ones of Assiya, which then clothed the four lower ones, TNHY, of Beria; and from them was made the discernment of the body of Adam HaRishon from the Chazeh downward, down to the Sium [end] of his Tifferet, as above. And the Malchut of the four first ones of Assiya, which was at the place of the Malchut of the present Beria, is the discernment of Syria, which is near Babylon. And the legs of Adam HaRishon, which are the discernment of the six lower ones of Assiya, which clothe the first six of Yetzira down to the Chazeh: this place is the discernment of outside the Land, and thus his legs are from the discernment of outside the Land. However, the legs are divided into three thirds, and his upper two thirds, called his buttocks, are from the discernment of the upper two thirds of the VAK [six ends] of Assiya, which are the discernment of Babylon, adjacent to Syria, which is the Malchut of the four first ones of Assiya, as above. And this is what he says, “It is not far-fetched that his body was from the Land of Israel and his buttocks from Babylon,” for only Syria and Trans-Jordan separate between them, which are the discernment of the four first Sefirot of Assiya, from which was made the part of his body from the Chazeh downward to the Sium of Tifferet, as above. Thus the upper two thirds of the VAK of Yetzira, which are Babylon, are adjacent to the discernment of the Land of Israel, that is, to the Malchut of Yetzira that was at the Chazeh of Beria, like his buttocks, which are adjacent to his body.
